# ghost/regex-crossword

Regex Crossword (F-Droid): list categories, open a level, read the regex clues and the grid, type the cells and verify. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/regex-crossword
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/regex-crossword list_levels --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/regex-crossword open_level --device <serial> --param category=<category> --param level=<level>
ghost skill run ghost/regex-crossword get_puzzle --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/regex-crossword enter --device <serial> --param rows=<rows>
ghost skill run ghost/regex-crossword verify --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `list_levels`: Which regex crossword categories are there?
- `open_level`: Open the Backreference regex crossword level
- `get_puzzle`: Show me the regex crossword clues
- `enter`: Type II in the crossword
- `verify`: Verify my crossword answer
